C_concentration.note: E_m = aligned energy = <U_m,V_m>^2/||V_m||^2. Compare each real direction to its rank-matched random control, NOT to k/252: module sizes are heterogeneous, so even a null direction concentrates.

E_random_control.construction: per module, A ~ N(0,1) of shape (rank, in), B ~ N(0,1) of shape (out, rank), then the whole delta rescaled so ||C_m||_F == ||V_m||_F for the matched real direction; rank 16 for C_syc, 32 for C_oracle (V_oracle = plain - neutral has rank <= 32)

F_oracle_artefact_check.why: V_oracle = dW(plain) - dW(neutral) contains U = dW(plain) as a term, so cos(U, V_oracle) is an algebraic function of ||U||, ||N||, <U,N> alone. For two ARBITRARY near-orthogonal equal-norm updates it is ~1/sqrt(2), i.e. an energy fraction of ~50%, with no trait structure required.
